title: The Worst Decision Arthur Morgan Ever Made 😭
description:
In chapter two, Dutch sends Arthur to Strawberry to break Micah Bell out of jail. After the gang came back from Guarma, the Pinkertons picked Micah up, and he fed them information. Arthur only hears it near the end, from Agent Milton himself. Would you have left Micah in that cell?

Sources: Red Dead Wiki, Micah Bell: https://reddead.fandom.com/wiki/Micah_Bell
